official_name.value: The University of Texas at Austin

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Agreement scope is University-wide (UG). Course access remains subject to departmental seat capacity and prerequisites.

eligible_majors.notes: University-wide undergraduate exchange agreement; check specific UT Austin college/department prerequisites.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: TOEFL iBT minimum 79 or IELTS minimum 6.5 required for non-native English speakers (or accepted equivalent/home institution attestation per Texas Global).

available_terms.notes: Fall/Spring/Summer/Winter | Excel Col E also notes Winter term

fall_term_dates.value: Fall 2026: Classes Aug 24–Dec 7, 2026; study days Dec 8–9, 2026; final exams Dec 10–12 & 14, 2026 (2026-27 academic calendar).

spring_term_dates.value: Spring 2027: Classes Jan 11–May 3, 2027; final exams Apr 29–30, May 1 & 3, 2027 (2026-27 academic calendar).
spring_term_dates.notes: Local 2020-21 fact sheet (University of Texas at Austin.docx) also notes Summer early June–mid August window.

tuition_model.notes: Reciprocal exchange students do not pay tuition to UT Austin and continue paying home institution tuition.

est_monthly_living_local.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/TUo Texas at Austin/University of Texas at Austin.docx
est_monthly_living_local.notes: Published monthly living estimate from 2020-21 local fact sheet ($1,400–$1,900/month). Current Texas Global J-1 DS-2019 proof minimum is $9,165 for 1 semester ($18,330 for 2 semesters) per https://global.utexas.edu/isss/students/exchange.

living_cost_usd_est.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/TUo Texas at Austin/University of Texas at Austin.docx
living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month USD estimate from 2020-21 fact sheet midpoint: ($1,400 + $1,900) / 2 = $1,650/month × 5 months = $8,250 USD (USD local currency, no FX conversion). Current J-1 DS-2019 financial proof requires at least $9,165/semester.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: UT Austin Student Health Insurance is mandatory for all J-1 exchange visitors and cannot be waived.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: Also confirmed in local fact sheet (University of Texas at Austin.docx, 2020-21).

housing_availability.notes: University Housing and Dining (UHD) residence halls, UT apartments, UT-managed off-campus properties (e.g., 2400 Nueces), and off-campus search support via Texas Global.

housing_notes.value: Housing options include on-campus UHD residence halls, UT apartments (such as East Campus Graduate Apartments), UT-managed off-campus apartments like 2400 Nueces, and private rentals/co-ops via Texas Global off-campus living resources.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Requires J-1 Exchange Visitor visa (Form DS-2019) issued after uploading financial proof in myIO: minimum $9,165 for 1 semester or $18,330 for 2 semesters.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: DS-2019 visa requirement also confirmed in local fact sheet (University of Texas at Austin.docx).

course_catalog_url.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/TUo Texas at Austin/University of Texas at Austin.docx
course_catalog_url.notes: Official UT Austin Course Schedules link extracted from fact sheet; see areas of study at https://www.utexas.edu/academics/areas-of-study.

credit_system_and_load.value: U.S. semester credit hours; reciprocal exchange students must maintain full-time enrollment: minimum 12 credit hours/semester for undergraduates (max 1 ESL course may count toward the 12-credit minimum), 10 for Law, and 9 for MBA.

course_restrictions_note.value: Full-time course of study required; at most one ESL course through the English Language Center may count toward the mandatory 12-credit-hour undergraduate full-time load, and departmental course approval/prerequisites apply.

value: Digital academic transcript uploaded via myIO after admission
English proficiency verification (TOEFL iBT 79 / IELTS 6.5 or accepted equivalent)
Proof of financial support via myIO for Form DS-2019
required_application_docs.notes: Official mailed paper transcripts are not required for initial application; admitted exchange students upload digital transcripts and financial proof in myIO.

academic_style.value: Comprehensive U.S. public research university offering undergraduate areas of study across multiple colleges and schools with mandatory full-time semester enrollment.

international_support_services.value: Texas Global / ISSS orientation, arrival check-in guidance, and International Hospitality Council (IHC) welcome and cultural programs.
international_support_services.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/TUo Texas at Austin/University of Texas at Austin.docx
international_support_services.notes: Links extracted from local fact sheet: https://global.utexas.edu/isss/welcome/ and https://global.utexas.edu/isss/programs/ihc.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall: nom window Jan 15–Feb 15 / app deadline Mar 1; Spring: nom window Jul 15–Aug 15 / app deadline Sep 1.
